status-default-disabled.statement: In the Add Microtenant drawer the Status is disabled by default.

quotes: Status: Enable the Microtenant. By default, this is disabled.

disable-effects.statement: Disabling a Microtenant terminates its active sessions, reassigns users mapped to it to the Default Microtenant, and makes users on Private Service Edges reauthenticate.

quotes: Users mapped to Microtenants that are using Private Service Edges for Private Access (ZPA) reauthenticate when the Microtenant is disabled.
Users that are mapped to a Microtenant are reassigned to the Default Microtenant when the Microtenant is disabled.
Active sessions for the Microtenant are terminated when the Microtenant is disabled.

admin-credentials-shown-once.statement: The Admin ID and Password are available only when adding a Microtenant and cannot be accessed in the Zscaler Admin Console after the window is closed.

quotes: The Admin ID and Password are only available when adding a Microtenant. They are not available to access in the Zscaler Admin Console after you close the window, so store them in a secure location.

privileged-approvals-purpose.statement: Enabling Privileged Approvals allows approval-based access even if no Authentication Domain is selected, it is Disabled by default, and a privileged approval must then be configured for that Microtenant.

quotes: Enable to allow approval-based access even if no Authentication Domain is selected.
This field is Disabled by default.
After you enable Privileged Approvals for a Microtenant, you need to configure a privileged approval for that Microtenant to provide users without Authentication Domain access.

privileged-approvals-pra-only.statement: The Privileged Approvals option is supported only for applications that have Privileged Remote Access enabled.

quotes: The Privileged Approvals option is only supported for applications that have Privileged Remote Access enabled.

emergency-pages-hidden.statement: The Emergency Access and Emergency Access Users pages are not visible for Microtenants with Privileged Approvals disabled.

quotes: The Emergency Access and Emergency Access Users pages are not visible for Microtenants with Privileged Approvals disabled.

enabled-default.summary: The console creates a Microtenant disabled by default, while the Python SDK docstring says `enabled` defaults to True.

quotes: Status: Enable the Microtenant. By default, this is disabled.

positions.says: The Status toggle in the Add Microtenant drawer is disabled by default.

quotes: enabled (bool): Whether the microtenant is enabled. Defaults to True.

positions.says: add_microtenant documents `enabled` as defaulting to True.

enabled-default.impact: A caller that omits `enabled` cannot rely on either default: the SDK passes its keyword arguments through as the body, so what the API applies when the field is absent is not shown by either source.

delete-resource-fate.title: What happens to a Microtenant's scoped resources when it is deleted
delete-resource-fate.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Behavior of scoped resources (App Segments, Server Groups and so on) on deletion is not documented, and resources should be moved or reassigned before deleting a Microtenant to avoid orphaned objects. The captures say deletion removes the associated log receivers and nothing else, and the SDK and provider issue a bare DELETE. A lab delete of a populated Microtenant would settle it.
delete-resource-fate.blocks: advising whether resources must be moved before deletion

pra-requires-privileged-approvals.title: Whether a Microtenant without Privileged Approvals can support PRA workflows scoped to it
pra-requires-privileged-approvals.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Privileged Approvals is per-Microtenant, and a Microtenant without it enabled cannot support PRA workflows scoped to it, regardless of PRA configuration on App Segments. The captures say only that Privileged Approvals is supported for PRA-enabled applications and that the Emergency Access pages are hidden without it. A lab test of a PRA application segment in a Microtenant with Privileged Approvals disabled would settle it.
pra-requires-privileged-approvals.blocks: answering whether PRA works at all in a Microtenant with Privileged Approvals disabled
